title: Hearty British Onion Tacos
description: Spicy, flaky, comforting British dish featuring corn tortillas, agemono-deep-fry, and a twist of Yorkshire flavors
instructions: In a large bowl, combine sliced onions and minced garlic.
Heat the beef dripping or lard in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the onions and garlic to the pan and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Add the Yorkshire Ale, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pan, stirring to combine.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer the onion mixture for 10-15 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium-high heat.
Cook the corn tortillas for 30-45 seconds on each side, until slightly charred and pliable.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the onion mixture onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of beef dripping or lard.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
